title: Woman Loses Arm After Alleged Molestation and Push at Naigaon Station; Suspect Arrested
excerpt: A 20-year-old on a Borivali-to-Virar local was allegedly pushed at Naigaon on November 4, fell between coaches and lost her left arm; police arrested a 53-year-old man after a CCTV review.
body:
• A 20-year-old woman lost her left arm after she was allegedly molested on a Borivali-to-Virar local train and pushed at Naigaon station on November 4.
  • She fell into the gap between two coaches as the train moved, her arm was run over, and she also received 16 stitches to her head, reports said.
  • Bhayandar Railway Police arrested a 53-year-old man, identified as Jitendra Hirmukhe of Naigaon East, after examining CCTV footage.
  • Police said he was booked for attempted murder and molestation; the investigation is ongoing.

A 20-year-old woman lost her left arm after she was allegedly molested on a Mumbai local train and pushed at Naigaon railway station on November 4. Bhayandar Railway Police have arrested a 53-year-old man in connection with the incident and booked him for attempted murder, according to reports by Daily Jagran and Mirror Now.

The woman had boarded a local train travelling from Borivali to Virar. According to her complaint, cited in the reports, the accused touched her inappropriately, which she described as a "bad touch," and she confronted him.

What the reports say happened at Naigaon

The confrontation escalated into an argument. The woman threw her slipper at the man, other passengers tried to intervene, and the man allegedly abused her and threw his slipper back at her, Daily Jagran reported, citing NDTV's account.

When the train reached Naigaon station, the accused allegedly pushed her off the train. She fell into the gap between two coaches. As she tried to climb back onto the platform, the train started moving and her left arm was caught under its wheels, the reports said. Surgeons amputated her left arm below the elbow, and she received 16 stitches to her head.

"I want justice. My entire life has been ruined."

— The 20-year-old woman, speaking to NDTV from her hospital bed, as reported by Daily Jagran

Mirror Now reported that she had boarded a compartment reserved for persons with disabilities because of heavy crowding, and that she was first taken to a local hospital before being transferred for specialised care. That detail comes from a single report and police have not, in the reports read for this article, laid out a full sequence in their own statement.

Arrest after CCTV review

The accused allegedly fled after the incident, covering his face with a handkerchief. Railway police examined CCTV footage from several locations, identified him and arrested him, the reports said.

"We examined CCTV footage from various locations and managed to identify and arrest the accused, who had covered his face with a handkerchief."

— Ganpat Tumbada, Senior Police Inspector, Bhayandar Railway Police Station

Police identified the accused as Jitendra Hirmukhe, a resident of Wakipada in Naigaon East. Mirror Now reported the charges as attempted murder and molestation, and said the investigation remains ongoing as police formalise the charges.

What is not yet established

The reports differ on some details, including exactly when the arrest took place, and none of the reports read for this article named a verified fundraiser or relief channel for the woman. This article therefore does not link one. Readers who want to help should wait for a channel named by the family or by a reputable outlet covering the case.

The case has renewed discussion in the coverage about women's safety on Mumbai's local trains, which carry large numbers of women commuters during rush hour every day. No official statement on additional safety measures was included in the reports read for this article.
